verdict.rationale: Shopify's versioning docs describe versioned APIs and libraries released on a predictable quarterly schedule. They state that developers get time to adopt changes before older versions are retired, and they point to a developer changelog for notices. missing for 10: an explicit support-window length per version, details of how deprecations are flagged (e.g. headers or in-schema deprecation notices), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Shopify releases new API versions on a predictable quarterly schedule, giving you time to adopt changes before older versions are retired.
Versioned APIs and libraries follow the quarterly release schedule described below.
